{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python - << 'EOF'
src = open('tests/test_journal.py').read()
old = """def test_preview_missing_remove_reports_nothing(env):
    db, w = env
    db.insert({'x': 1})
    # A batch that cannot succeed produces no inserted IDs
    assert w.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 2}},
                      {'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 99}]) == []
    # A remove of an ID inserted earlier in the same batch is fine
    assert w.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 2}},
                      {'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 2}]) == [2]
    assert [d['x'] for d in db.all()] == [1]"""
new = """def test_preview_missing_remove_raises_like_apply(env):
    db, w = env
    db.insert({'x': 1})
    # Mirror apply: a remove targeting a missing ID is an error, and
    # nothing (data or next-ID state) changes.
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        w.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 2}},
                   {'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 99}])
    assert [d['x'] for d in db.all()] == [1]
    assert db.insert({'x': 2}) == 2
    # A remove of an ID inserted earlier in the same batch is fine
    assert w.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 3}},
                      {'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 3}]) == [3]
    assert [d['x'] for d in db.all()] == [1, 2]"""
assert old in src
open('tests/test_journal.py','w').write(src.replace(old, new))
print('patched')
EOF
python -m pytest -o addopts= tests/test_journal.py -q 2>&1 | tail -3"}
